issue.title: [warmboot] vlan_port_down SAD case failure: downstream traffic loss before warmboot

failure.body:
#### Description

Warm reboot SAD testcase `vlan_port_down` is failing consistently. This is a regression. Last good image: SONiC-OS-20201231.01

The error may not be with vlan_port_down case, but with the preceeding sad-case(s) which left DUT in bad state.
More information to be added here.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run test `platform_tests.test_advanced_reboot.test_warm_reboot_multi_sad` (specific sad case: `vlan_port_down`)
2. The test will fail with downstream traffic experiencing drops even before warmboot. Hence the warmboot never happens as "DUT is not ready for test".
3.

#### Describe the results you received:

In the sequence of preboot actions in sad cases, the test fails as DUT is not in good state.
SAD cases:
```
        prebootList = [
            'neigh_bgp_down',               # Shutdown single BGP session on remote device (VM) before reboot DUT
            'dut_bgp_down',                 # Shutdown single BGP session on DUT brefore rebooting it
            'dut_lag_down',                 # Shutdown single LAG session on DUT brefore rebooting it
            'neigh_lag_down',               # Shutdown single LAG session on remote device (VM) before reboot DUT
            'dut_lag_member_down:1:1',      # Shutdown 1 LAG member corresponding to 1 remote device (VM) on DUT
            'neigh_lag_member_down:1:1',    # Shutdown 1 LAG member on 1 remote device (VM)
            'vlan_port_down',               # Shutdown 1 vlan port (interface) on DUT
        ]
```

```
E                   "======================================================================",
E                   "FAIL: advanced-reboot.ReloadTest",
E                   "----------------------------------------------------------------------",
E                   "Traceback (most recent call last):",
E                   "  File \"ptftests/advanced-reboot.py\", line 1211, in runTest",
E                   "    self.handle_post_reboot_test_reports()",
E                   "  File \"ptftests/advanced-reboot.py\", line 1161, in handle_post_reboot_test_reports",
E                   "    self.assertTrue(is_good, errors)",
E                   "AssertionError: ",
E                   "",
E                   "Something went wrong. Please check output below:",
E                   "",
E                   "FAILED:dut:Control plane didn't come up within warm up timeout",
E                   "FAILED:dut:DUT is not ready for test",
E                   "",
E                   "",
E                   "----------------------------------------------------------------------",
```

#### Describe the results you expected:

All SAD cases in warmreboot test should pass.

#### Output of `show version`:

ALL platforms (brcm, mlnx).

20201231.06

resolution.title: Fix sad path for advanced reboot test with multiple VLANs

### Description of PR

Summary: Fix sad path for advanced reboot test with multiple VLANs
Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/issues/3738
Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/8048

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] Test case(new/improvement)

### Back port request
- [ ] 201911

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Fix sad path for advanced reboot test with multiple VLANs.

#### How did you do it?
Allow sad path to change the port list for each VLAN so that the advanced reboot test gets the proper VLAN port list after conducting the VLAN sad operations.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Verify that the sad warm reboot test cases do not experience traffic drops before warmboot.
